svg.title: Smart Search: find code by what it does
svg.desc: The model calls smart_search with a plain-English query. SmartSearch lists the files in the workspace with rg --files, chunks them into snippets, shortlists up to 128 snippets with BM25, and sends each one to the judge model you chose. Snippets whose relevance reaches the threshold come back to the model as a SmartSearchResult with file, line range and a short excerpt, plus coverage figures and warnings.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
